description.value: Kamini's Corner Café is a small, community-minded café in New Westminster serving fresh homemade breakfasts, lunches, and baked goods to a loyal local following. Beyond dine-in, it offers corporate and event catering across the Lower Mainland, as well as weeknight dinner takeout and frozen meals — useful for cyclists needing a hearty hot meal or something to take on the road. The menu includes vegetarian options and gluten-free desserts, and reviewers consistently praise the welcoming atmosphere and quality of the food.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms a real, active café in New Westminster — not North Vancouver as the OSM community field states — with consistent footer address of 909 12th Street, New Westminster, BC V3M 4K5. A temporary closure notice (Jan 23–Feb 28, 2026) has passed as of today (May 28, 2026), so the business appears currently open. No bike-specific amenities (rack, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the site; takeout and vegetarian/GF menu items are explicitly confirmed.
concerns: OSM community field says 'North Vancouver' but the website consistently identifies the location as New Westminster, BC — the OSM record appears to be geocoded or tagged to the wrong municipality.

Address discrepancy within the website itself: the site footer on every page shows '909 12th Street' but the /cafe/ and /contact/ page body text both show '902 12th Street' — the canonical street number is uncertain.
Two different phone numbers appear on the website: the footer consistently shows 778.955.7320 while the /contact/ page body lists +1 (604) 544-5128.
OSM tag outdoor_seating=no contradicts the website's /cafe/ page ('indoor and outdoor seating available') and a customer review praising the outdoor seating — OSM tag appears outdated.
Website displayed a temporary closure notice for Jan 23–Feb 28, 2026; that period has passed and the business appears open, but the notice was not removed at time of content fetch.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating café with an active website, confirmed menu, and takeout service — straightforwardly useful to touring cyclists for food and rest.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists Veggie Omelette, Gluten Free Chocolate Cheesecake, and Gluten Free New York Cheesecake explicitly

wow_evidence: small, community-minded café in New Westminster serving fresh homemade breakfasts
